_comment: Shared test vectors for canonical_body_sha256 -- the ONE hash function stamped at
all three sites of the send-render conformance chain (skill pre_run envelope +
EMITTED_WAKE, overlay CONFIRM_SEND_DISPATCHED, console verifier). Definition:
sha256 over utf-8 of (CRLF normalized to LF, per-line trailing whitespace
stripped, trailing newlines stripped). This fixture is the ARBITER: both repos'
test suites load it and assert their implementation maps every input to its
sha256. It is copied VERBATIM into hermes-smd-overlay tests/fixtures/ in the
same change whenever it moves (mirrored-artifact discipline, same as the
seat/gate snapshot). Vectors are synthetic text only -- never a real body.
operator/bin/tests/test_send_verify.py, and the overlay's emitter suite
(lands with the render cluster's pair PR).

vectors.name: trailing_newline
vectors.note: REQUIRED vector: one trailing newline strips; must hash identical to plain_two_lines

vectors.name: many_trailing_newlines
vectors.note: all trailing newlines strip, not just one

vectors.name: crlf_line_endings
vectors.note: CRLF normalizes to LF before hashing

vectors.name: trailing_whitespace
vectors.note: per-line trailing spaces and tabs strip

vectors.name: interior_blank_preserved
vectors.note: an interior blank line is content and survives

vectors.name: interior_vs_no_blank_differ
vectors.note: control for interior_blank_preserved: must differ from it

vectors.name: unicode_body
vectors.note: utf-8 encoding, not a byte-latin fallback

vectors.name: empty_string
vectors.note: the empty body hashes the empty canonical form

vectors.name: only_newlines
vectors.note: a body of nothing but newlines canonicalizes to empty; must hash identical to empty_string
